name: insert-between-button
title: Insert between button
description: The plus that appears between two items so you can insert one right there: on hover and focus, always on touch, and reachable by keyboard.
docs: index is the position the new item takes; the name reads Insert step between 2 and 3 (pass between for real names). Put one in every gap of your list, and move focus to the new item in onInsert.
